title: ISO/IEC 42006: The Emerging AI Management Systems Audit Standard
hook_questions: How will ISO/IEC 42006 change AI auditing requirements?
What is the relationship between ISO 42001 certification and 42006 audit?
When does the 42006 standard take effect and who must comply?
answer_summary: ISO/IEC 42006 provides the auditing framework for AI management systems certified under ISO/IEC 42001. It specifies auditor competence, audit methodology, evidence collection, and reporting requirements. Unlike self-declared conformity, 42006 mandates independent third-party assessment with documented competence criteria for auditors. The standard is expected to reach FDIS stage in late 2026 with publication in early 2027.
regulatory_context: The EU AI Act references harmonized standards as a conformity pathway. ISO/IEC 42006, when published, is expected to be adopted as a harmonized standard under the AI Act, making it a de facto requirement for high-risk AI system certification in Europe. The UK AI Assurance Ecosystem and Singapore AI Verify framework both track 42006 development for cross-recognition.
council_position: Verified measurement credential with audit-grade evidence chains. Council of AI certification maps to 42006 audit criteria with additional cryptographic integrity guarantees.
